<?php
class TypedArrayIsset {
    private int $hidden = 41;
    public function __isset(string $name): bool { echo "I", $name, ";"; return $name !== "gone"; }
    public function __get(string $name): array { echo "BAD_GET;"; return 7; }
}
$receiver = new TypedArrayIsset;
echo isset($receiver->hidden) ? "PRESENT;" : "BAD;";
echo isset($receiver->gone) ? "BAD;" : "ABSENT;";
$selector = "hidden";
echo isset($receiver->$selector) ? "CV;" : "BAD;";
echo $selector === "hidden" ? "NAME;" : "BAD;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class TypedIntSkip {
    private int $hidden = 41;
    public function __get(string $name): int { echo "BAD_GET;"; return null; }
}
$receiver = new TypedIntSkip;
$alias = $receiver;
echo empty($receiver->hidden) ? "EMPTY;" : "BAD;";
echo $alias === $receiver ? "SAME;" : "BAD;";
echo "DONE;";
